evidence.evidence_summary: Collects one cycle for every active customer connection and commits the session.
evidence.excerpt:
207 | async def collect_once(
   208 |     session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] = async_session_factory,
   209 |     connection_manager: Any = customer_connection_manager,
   210 |     previous_state: dict[UUID, tuple[datetime, dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]]]] | None = None,
   211 | ) -> dict[str, int]:
   212 |     """Collect one cycle for every active customer connection."""
   213 |     previous_state = previous_state if previous_state is not None else {}
   214 |     totals = {"connections": 0, "queries": 0, "tables": 0, "plans": 0, "errors": 0}
   215 |     async with session_factory() as session:
   216 |         records = (await session.execute(
   217 |             select(DatabaseConnection).where(DatabaseConnection.is_active.is_(True))
   218 |         )).scalars().all()
   219 |         for record in records:
   220 |             totals["connections"] += 1
   221 |             previous = previous_state.get(record.id)
   222 |             try:
   223 |                 async with session.begin_nested():
   224 |                     pool = await connection_manager.get_customer_pool(record.id, db=session)
   225 |                     table_state = previous[1] if previous else {}
   226 |                     counts = await collect_connection_telemetry(
   227 |                         record.id,
   228 |                         pool,
   229 |                         session,
   230 |                         previous_tables=table_state,
   231 |                         previous_captured_at=previous[0] if previous else None,
   232 |                     )
   233 |                 captured_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
   234 |                 previous_state[record.id] = (captured_at, table_state)
   235 |                 for key in ("queries", "tables", "plans"):
   236 |                     totals[key] += counts[key]
   237 |             except Exception:
   238 |                 totals["errors"] += 1
   239 |                 logger.exception("Telemetry collection failed", extra={"connection_id": str(record.id)})
   240 |         await session.commit()
